verdict.rationale: CodeRabbit ships a built-in AI assistant you can hand tasks to across several surfaces. In PRs, you can chat with @coderabbitai, issue commands, and prompt it to generate its own improvements. One-click agentic Finishing Touches fix findings, resolve merge conflicts, generate unit tests and run custom recipes, and a Slack agent does investigation, planning and code editing, with chat also available in Change Stack. missing for 10: independent hands-on corroboration of task delegation (community evidence only indirectly notes it can write tests and committable fixes)
